verdict.rationale: Sill is a free, open-source app that streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad. A product of this kind could plausibly expose an API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a public API reference, let alone an interactive one with runnable examples, and probes for openapi/swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
